annotations.title: Find the website of a business

description: Finds the website of a business from its name, or reads an address. A name is searched on the web and each candidate site is read and ranked; when two sites carry the name about equally, ask is true and the person should say which is theirs. Returns each candidate's address, name, a sentence about it and the evidence for it. Free of credits.

country.description: The person's country as two letters, such as IN. It decides between sites that carry the same name.

query.description: The business's name, or its website address.

name: ugcfans_find_business
